anchor_desc: Computes the line subtotal by multiplying order quantity by unit price.

cases.name: unrelated_line_changed
cases.note: Edits an unrelated return line; the anchored line is byte-identical and barely shifts.

cases.name: lines_inserted_above
cases.note: Inserts four validation lines above the anchor; it shifts down but stays identical.

cases.name: whitespace_change
cases.note: Removes the spaces around the multiplication operator; the tokens are unchanged.

cases.name: trailing_punct_added
cases.expect_text: subtotal = order.quantity * order.unit_price  # base before tax
cases.note: Appends a trailing comment to the anchored line; the code expression is unchanged.

cases.name: variable_renamed
cases.note: Renames the assigned variable subtotal to base_amount; the right-hand expression is identical.

cases.name: rename_and_ops_changed
cases.note: Renames the variable and also adds an extra operand on the same line, a Type-3 near-miss.

cases.name: anchor_line_deleted
cases.note: Replaces the multiplication with a method call so the anchored computation no longer exists.

cases.name: boilerplate_trap
cases.note: Deletes the anchored subtotal assignment while leaving the structurally similar lines that reference subtotal.
